chain.label: Dark, featureless night over widening river south of bridge
chain.trigger: a new moon was below the horizon and provided no illumination; south of the bridge the area becomes "very dark"

chain.label: Low-altitude cruise about 200 ft over the Potomac on helicopter route 4
chain.trigger: the helicopter was about 0.25 nm north of the Woodrow Wilson Bridge at an altitude of about 200 feet

chain.label: Radar altimeter inoperative, deferred under the MEL
chain.trigger: The maintenance logbook ... included an entry dated January 10, 2005, for an inoperative radar altimeter

chain.label: Pilot accepted visual separation and diverted attention outside to acquire the Airbus
chain.trigger: "roger we have him in sight and will be out of his way"

chain.label: Instrument scan not maintained when crossing into the black void
chain.trigger: the pilot diverted his attention from the instruments, at least momentarily, because he stated to the controller that he was looking for the approaching Airbus traffic

caused_by.evidence: about 8 seconds before the onset of the helicopter's banking descent, the pilot diverted his attention from the instruments
Because the helicopter was traveling in dark conditions over featureless terrain, the pilot would have needed to reference the flight instruments

chain.label: Loss of altitude awareness; featureless-terrain illusion with no outside references
chain.trigger: he would have had few or no outside visual ground references to provide information about the helicopter's altitude, and detection of an unintentional descent ... would have been difficult

caused_by.evidence: If the pilot had continued to look out the windscreen for the traffic, he would have had few or no outside visual ground references
An absence of ground features, as when landing over water, darkened areas ... can create the illusion that the aircraft is at a higher altitude than it actually is
If a functioning radar altimeter had been available to and used by the pilot, it could have provided a constant altitude cue

chain.label: Undetected gradual descent and right bank after crossing the bridge
chain.trigger: it entered a gradual descent and right bank, and, about 14 seconds later, it impacted the water

caused_by.evidence: detection of an unintentional descent during this time would have been difficult using external cues
the visual alerter features of the radar altimeter could have provided the pilot additional tools to alert him that the helicopter had descended below a set altitude
he would have had to respond immediately to arrest it because of the helicopter's cruise speed and low altitude

chain.label: Helicopter struck the Potomac River nose-low in a right bank
chain.trigger: the helicopter struck the water at a 3º nose-low and 12º right-bank attitude

caused_by.evidence: then it entered a gradual descent and right bank, and, about 14 seconds later, it impacted the water

chain.label: Two occupants killed, one seriously injured; helicopter destroyed
chain.trigger: The certificated commercial pilot and the flight paramedic were killed, and the flight nurse received serious injuries.

caused_by.evidence: crashed into the Potomac River ... the pilot's cause of death was "multiple injuries"; the flight paramedic's cause of death was listed as "drowning complicated by hypothermia"
